_about: SCP stage machine, the single source both sides test against (FRONTEND-BFF-CONTRACT §63.3, PERMISSION-CONTRACT §53; plan docs/plans/2026-10-15-social-content-pipeline.md §4.3). platform-nest loads this file in its stage-machine suites; platform-ui keeps a byte-identical twin (platform-ui/src/lib/scpStageMachine.json, added by the first UI ticket that needs it at runtime) and a test that compares the bytes, the clientHealthGolden.json pattern. Edit this file first, then the twin. Every value here is data: no client or staff names.

pseudoTargets.deleted: discard soft-deletes the post (deleted_at); it is in no list and reads 404
pseudoTargets.archived: archive sets archived_at; pipeline_status keeps the status it had, the engine status becomes 'archived', and the post leaves every list

portalStatusRefusal: On the portal routes a post the caller may not see is 404 post_not_found, and a visible post outside the action's 'from' is 409 post_not_with_client (not invalid_transition).

phaseOf.changes: from the change case: see changeCases[].phase

phaseRule: phase = phaseOf[status]; for status 'changes', phase = changeCases[the post's (changeBy, changeKind, returnTo)].phase. Equivalently: changeBy 'client' gives client_changes; else returnTo 'final' or changeKind 'design' gives in_production; else brief.

engineStatus.rule: social_posts.status of a pipeline post is written only by the stage machine, in the same UPDATE as pipeline_status: byPipelineStatus, then the first matching override, top to bottom.

holders.scheduled: officer when scheduleVia is 'manual'; publisher when 'publisher'
holders.changes: from the change case: see changeCases[].holder

primaryAction.design: start_design while creativeState is 'not_started', else submit_design

actors.officer: the client's officer: social_engagements.owner_id of the post's engagement (Cerbos attribute ownerId, rule member + variables.owns)
actors.copywriter: a holder of the social_copywriter role in the company (Cerbos derived role social_copywriter)
actors.approver: a social approver: a holder of a live lead seat on the company's Social Media unit or its GM unit (Cerbos attribute approverIds), a social_manager grant, or company_admin. Never the post's author or the client's officer (the DENY rule).
actors.designer: creativeSource 'creatives': an assignee of the client-month Creatives request's PM task (Cerbos attribute assigneeIds); creativeSource 'in_team': a holder of the social_designer role (Cerbos derived role social_designer)
actors.client: an active portal contact of the post's client (Cerbos portal action approve_post, or approve_spend for money)
actors.recorder: a member of staff recording a decision the client gave outside the portal: officer or approver (Cerbos record_client); for money, social_engagement set_scope
actors.publisher: the system: the publisher's result through the dispatch path, or the simulator when SOCIAL_SIMULATION_ENABLED is on
actors.company_admin: holds every new action through its own rule, and is still refused by the author DENY

actors: client with signing capability on the client

editRules.note: the client has seen the networks, so the placement stays

requiredToSend.rule: placement names at least one network, each one of the client's platforms

handoffChecks.rule: all ten must-haves are ticked: logo, brand_colours, brand_fonts, contact_info, handle_and_tags, mandatory_words, no_forbidden_claims, price_terms_checked, location_tag, hashtag_set
caption plus hashtags within each placement network's limit (2,200 characters on Instagram)
at most 30 hashtags when Instagram is placed
onAssetText is not blank when the format needs it (feed, carousel, story)
every rawAssets entry has a link; until the Drive OAuth client exists (DW-11) a present link passes
every rawAssets entry has a source other than 'unknown'
every rawAssets entry with source 'ai' has an AI note
scheduledAt is not before the cycle's ready-by (such a post needs an earlier hand-off than the rest)

handoffCheckRule: send_to_proofread refuses 409 checks_failed with blockers[] listing every failing handoff check, unless sendAnyway is true with a sendAnywayReason (10 to 500 characters); then the skipped codes, the reason, the actor and the time are appended to skipped_checks and written to the activity. requiredToSend failures are 409 incomplete_post and can never be sent anyway.

commonGuards.outcome: 200 alreadyApplied: the same actionId as the post's last applied action

commonGuards.refusal: the action's own codes, in the order listed

actions.plan: §4.3: in proofread the Copywriter's edits are suggestions

the reviewHash the client was shown

systemRules.when: a variant's content hash changes (a Composer edit, a media attach) while the post is approved, or scheduled with scheduleVia 'manual'
systemRules.then: the post returns to client: its reviews are re-requested (pending), scheduleVia is cleared, activity 'content_changed_after_client'
systemRules.plan: §4.3: a content edit after the client approved sends the post back to the client

systemRules.when: a variant's content hash changes while the post is scheduled with scheduleVia 'publisher' and no variant is queued yet
systemRules.then: its pending publish approvals are withdrawn, the post returns to client as above
systemRules.plan: §4.3; addendum D-15 (an edit invalidates an approval)

systemRules.when: the dispatch path reports every variant of a scheduled post published
systemRules.then: mark_live by the publisher (liveUrl from the first published variant)

systemRules.when: a variant of a scheduled post fails
systemRules.then: the post stays scheduled; its engine status becomes failed; the Failed posts tile counts it; the officer may unschedule and fix
systemRules.plan: §8 3b: a failed publish shows on the Failed posts tile

systemRules.then: planned, drafting and copy changes: an edit; approved and scheduled by hand: the schedule action's own write, the client's approval stands (the review hash excludes the date, §63.1); scheduled through the publisher: 409 unschedule_first; live: 409 post_is_live

boosts.remainingRule: remaining = agreed monthly budget of the boost's cycle (0 when none) minus the sum of total budgets (daily budget x days) of that cycle's boosts in committedStatuses; computed under a per-cycle lock; never below 0 for display

effects: warning spend_above_budget when spend exceeds the total budget
